confirmed_gaps.evidence: DescribeDBClusters DBCluster has BacktrackWindow but no BacktrackingSupported; no collector derivation exists. Removing this synthetic field from the positive item and mirrored dependency inventory yields UNKNOWN missing fact: BacktrackingSupported.
confirmed_gaps.fix: Require native BacktrackWindow; explicit positive PASS and zero FAIL follow SDK field documentation; missing/negative/malformed UNKNOWN. Known non-Aurora engines retain NOT_APPLICABLE.

confirmed_required_producer_gaps.evidence: Native GetInstances has neither field and this kind has no registered fetcher or enricher. The base deep-copy enrichment has no Lightsail-instance branch or SSM association. No native instance-to-SSM identity match is supplied.
confirmed_required_producer_gaps.fix_proposal: Design a reliable owner-approved Lightsail-to-SSM identity binding, then request-bound DescribeInstancePatchStates; retain UNKNOWN until that binding exists.

confirmed_required_producer_gaps.current_fix: Sibling-owned native environment/resources/LB listener/attributes producer and documented managed log path resolution; no delivered-log or retention claim.
confirmed_required_producer_gaps.evidence: Native DescribeEnvironments Resources.LoadBalancer is a different shape. The only fetcher/enricher reads DescribeEnvironments and filtered DescribeConfigurationSettings; neither produces EnvironmentResources/AssociatedLoadBalancers or invokes DescribeEnvironmentResources and LB joins.
confirmed_required_producer_gaps.fix_proposal: Add complete native environment-resource association and name/ARN-bound ELB/ELBv2 listener reads before evaluating TLS; do not rename the shallow native Resources object.

confirmed_required_producer_gaps.current_fix: Sibling-owned native environment/resources/LB listener/attributes producer and documented managed log path resolution; no delivered-log or retention claim.
confirmed_required_producer_gaps.evidence: Same unproduced environment-to-load-balancer join; no associated native attributes/log destination are emitted by this route.
confirmed_required_producer_gaps.fix_proposal: Share a complete environment-resource/LB join and explicitly read LB attributes with identity and coverage validation.

confirmed_required_producer_gaps.current_fix: Sibling-owned native environment/resources/LB listener/attributes producer and documented managed log path resolution; no delivered-log or retention claim.

confirmed_required_producer_gaps.fix_proposal: Retain documented hostmanager publication metadata with native completeness and derive a verified S3 destination; do not invent an inferred bucket/prefix.

evidence_boundary: Review status covers identified accessor fields only, not exhaustive semantics. SDK shape membership proves only API-boundary possibility; credited field emission requires an executed modeled or source-bound SDK pipeline receipt. Derived-producer means the actual callback emitted the path in a modeled probe or a passing SDK-pipeline receipt with matching recorded test-source and collector-pipeline hashes; this does not prove values, availability, branch completeness, SDK parameter correctness, or real-world success. Fixtures prove reads only. No cloud calls, live proof, or new broad predicate gate.

lightsail_ssm_identity_review.conclusion: No documented immutable Lightsail ARN to SSM managed-node ID binding in the reviewed installed SDK read surfaces. supportCode is documented only as a support lookup code. IP/name/tags/supportCode heuristics are not accepted.
lightsail_ssm_identity_review.proposal: Root-owned unsupported_exact_contract archival under the current native read-only contract, preserving active managed-node patch alternatives. This does not claim every future provider interface is impossible.
lightsail_ssm_identity_review.support_code_documentation: The support code. Include this code in your email to support when you have questions about an instance or another resource in Lightsail. This code enables our support team to look up your Lightsail information more easily.

limitations: Literal get/optional/api_optional, direct dict.get/subscript and FIELD_SPECS reads are statically enumerated; saved-fixture dict subclasses additionally trace direct input reads with baseline status/evidence equality. Derived copies, aliases and unvisited control-flow branches remain unproved.
Source-traced AccountId/Region append metadata is credited separately from service API responses.

Each kind has a separate public collector pipeline probe, exercising actual nested dispatch, provenance and omission normalization. Empty/error envelopes and missed optional branches remain unproved; callback-only and public receipts are distinguished per field.
Modeled SDK output is validated, but placeholder identities, optional combinations, request parameters and real service availability are not certified.

Observed get/subscript reads are strict accesses in particular visited branches, not proof that the field is universally required; optional() can internally call get(). Candidate lists are not confirmed bugs.
Optional content retrieval is disabled; those callbacks retain explicit unproved content-producer fields.

producer_triage.current_contract: EffectiveAdminAccess is no longer consumed; current legacy evaluator reads native role policies and exact AdministratorAccess attachment, with conservative unresolved effective semantics.
producer_triage.evidence: GetAccountAuthorizationDetails RoleDetail has no effective-admin result. _iam emits policy documents/PolicySources but no analysis of boundaries/session/SCP/Denies.

producer_triage.current_contract: Exact listening/process reachability is archived; route/SG facts do not prove host listening. No complete PublicReachability producer is claimed.
producer_triage.evidence: DescribeInstances has no joined route/ingress/listener proof. _enrich and unique_instances do not construct the required complete PublicReachability projection.
producer_triage.exclusion_reason: The exact signed predicate requires a public path to a listening port and the historical handler requires ListeningPortVerified plus complete listener/target/route/ingress inventories. The available independently validated native model proves only a bounded direct IPv4 configuration allowance, with application_listening=unknown and all_paths_evaluated=false. Neither that positive witness nor its absence settles the old listener contract. PublicReachability assertions in legacy fixtures have no authoritative listener producer. Quarantine this exact historical contract while preserving lineage and keeping the active native configuration alternatives available. This is an unsupported evidence/semantics classification, not an owner-input requirement or a blanket claim that future AWS-native ELB/telemetry proofs are impossible.

producer_triage.current_contract: aws_ec2_clock_metadata.enrich produces request-bound TimeOffset.ValueMilliseconds from exact CWAgent/time_offset GetMetricStatistics; absence/denial/malformed remains unavailable.
producer_triage.evidence: DescribeInstances has no CWAgent sample; the instance pipeline does not query or join CWAgent/time_offset metric data.

producer_triage.current_contract: Legacy CloudTrailObjectsByPrefix is not produced or consumed. Consumer now reads cloudtrail_account_inventory.CloudTrailS3DeliveryObjects from organization-trail metadata reads, not SIEM receipt or content evidence.
producer_triage.evidence: ListBuckets does not include prefix object listings. _buckets performs settings reads; no branch builds the required trail-specific ListObjectsV2 keyed projection.
GetObjectLockConfiguration returns ObjectLockConfiguration.ObjectLockEnabled, stored by _buckets under ObjectLock without flattening. The evaluator reads one level too high.
producer_triage.fix: Require native ObjectLockConfiguration wrapper; do not accept the old flat synthetic fixture.

producer_triage.evidence: The native path is ObjectLock.ObjectLockConfiguration.Rule.DefaultRetention. No collector flattens ObjectLockConfiguration for this callback.
producer_triage.fix: Require native ObjectLockConfiguration wrapper; do not accept the old flat synthetic fixture.

producer_triage.current_contract: aws_launch_template_instance_metadata reads GetLaunchTemplateData for tagged instances and projects request-bound NetworkInterfaces flags before caching; no raw user data retained.
producer_triage.evidence: GetLaunchTemplateData can return this field, but the instance pipeline only reads DescribeInstances/DescribeInstanceAttribute; it never calls GetLaunchTemplateData. Launch-template Versions is a different kind/source.

historical_field_removal.reason: instance launch template network metadata incomplete

producer_triage.evidence: GetBuckets bucket shape has accessRules. Actual aws_facts_swc._lightsail _pick retains only name/arn/accessLogConfig/resourcesReceivingAccess; executing it drops accessRules.
producer_triage.fix: Retain native accessRules; public FAIL, private with no overrides PASS, private allowing object overrides UNKNOWN without claiming complete object exposure.

producer_triage.evidence: GetBuckets does not supply an S3-control PublicAccessBlockConfiguration, and neither Lightsail route constructs AccountPublicAccessBlock. Existing narrow IAM bucket route also has no such fact.
producer_triage.fix: Retain native accessRules; public FAIL, private with no overrides PASS, private allowing object overrides UNKNOWN without claiming complete object exposure.

producer_triage.current_contract: aws_iam_report_native generates AWS Read-classified SERVICE_LEVEL jobs only for selected usage checks, validates session/account/principal/job identity, paginates within one bounded batch deadline and preserves denied or incomplete reports as UNKNOWN. Access history does not prove effective permissions.
producer_triage.evidence: _services_last_accessed relies on _sla_reports, which deliberately returns no rows and generation_disabled because existing job IDs cannot be enumerated read-only. This is a known evidence boundary, not a new projection bug.
